title: Typing Style
slide_intent: Teach typists to extend the alignment already present in the letterhead. A common starting edge and visible paragraph breaks help the recipient follow the message.
strategic_value: NASA can make everyday correspondence look related even when different offices type their own letters.
demonstration: A worked letter aligns its date, address, body and signoff with the printed name block. The matching envelope appears below.
practical_value: Use the printed identification to locate the left typing margin. Separate paragraphs with line space.

content_islands.name: Typing rule
content_islands.spec: Place the heading at left and explain the shared margin and paragraph spacing in two short columns at the top.

content_islands.name: Letter and envelope
content_islands.spec: Stack the completed letter above a wider envelope. Preserve the typewritten address, paragraph breaks, signature, return information and postal indicia so readers can compare both pieces.
